description: The pull request does what the issue asked — the token exchange retries once — and also shortens the session lifetime from 24 hours to 1, which no requirement asks for, with a test of the shorter lifetime: a test does not turn an unasked-for change into one that was asked for. The last change is a comment in oauth.ts, which is left out before anything is asked.
intent: The OAuth token exchange should retry once when the provider drops a request.

spec.title: Retry a dropped token exchange once

requirements.text: A failed OAuth token exchange is retried once before the login fails.

sourceRefs.quote: The OAuth token exchange should retry once when the provider drops a request.
